headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.49 (95% CI: 0.33–0.73), suggesting that tomato is associated with a lower risk of renal cell carcinoma. These findings were supported by low between-study heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
